Most SaaS sites start with the wrong problems

The hard part isn't building features. It's building a site that doesn't feel generic, doesn't drift apart over time, and doesn't take a month of weekends.

Starting fresh slows you down

Every SaaS needs the same 12 sections. Rebuilding them for every project costs weeks you should spend on the product.

Generic templates devalue work

Most free templates look like templates. Your product deserves a site that feels deliberate, not stamped out.

Unstable systems break with growth

Ad-hoc colors, magic numbers, drift between pages — small inconsistencies compound until every change risks breaking something else.

A design system, not just a template

RicoFast is built on a documented token system — colors, type scale, spacing, motion — so every page you add stays coherent with the ones already shipped. Less arbitration, fewer regressions, more time on the product.

Everything you need, nothing you don't

A focused set of features built for real SaaS sites. No bloat, no half-finished add-ons.

Clean page structure

9 pre-built pages — Home, Features, Pricing, Blog, Changelog, About, Contact, Elements, 404 — wired and responsive out of the box.

Reusable sections

15+ modular section components — Hero, FeatureGrid, Pricing, FAQ, Steps, FinalCTA — composable with no layout conflicts.

MDX-powered content

Blog and changelog driven by Astro 6 Content Layer. Import components inside Markdown. No CMS needed.

Lightweight and fast

Zero JS by default. Lighthouse 95+ on Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO from a fresh install.

Built-in motion

Scroll reveals via AOS, orchestrated entrances via motion.js. Honors prefers-reduced-motion.

Easy to customize

~30 CSS custom properties drive every color and font. Rebrand in minutes by editing one file.

A full layout system, not just sections

Hero, features, pricing, dashboards, settings — every page is composed from the same token system, so the whole product feels coherent.

Frequently asked questions

Yes. RicoFast is MIT-licensed and free for both personal and commercial use. Fork it, ship with it, sell what you build on top of it — no attribution required.
Basic HTML/CSS familiarity is enough. The template is structured so the first 90% of customization happens in three places: site.js, global.css tokens, and content directories. Most users ship without writing any new Astro components.
Yes. Colors, fonts, spacing, and border radii are all CSS custom properties defined in src/styles/global.css. The full token reference lives in docs/DESIGN.md so you always know what to change.
Anywhere that hosts static sites — Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, AWS S3, or your own server. The build outputs a plain dist/ directory. Vercel and Netlify have one-click setup.
Lighthouse 95+ across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO on a fresh install. Astro ships zero JS by default — interactive bits load only where needed.
Yes — open an issue on GitHub. The repo is actively maintained and community contributions are welcome. The Pro/Enterprise tiers shown on the Pricing page are demo content for the template itself, not a paid plan for RicoFast.
